newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan car shares active in early morning Tokyo.
newsitem.headline: Japan car shares active in early morning Tokyo.

text.p: Japanese car shares were actively traded in early Monday morning trade, but their prices were mixed depending on the outcome of their earnings results, brokers said.
Toyota Motor Corp and Honda Motor Co Ltd, which posted solid profits, were higher.
As of 0054 GMT, Toyota shares were 20 yen higher at 2,870 yen, and were the most actively traded issue on the first section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange in a trading volume of 2.141 million.
Honda, the fourth most actively traded in a volume of 1.155 million shares, was up 30 yen to 2,860 yen.
Honda said on Friday that its parent current profit for the first six months of the business year was 69.21 billion yen against 16.13 billion in the previous year.
Mazda Motor Corp, on the other hand, was down 20 yen to 485 yen, the third most active in trade of 1.499 million.
Also on Friday, Mazda posted an interim operating loss of 12.67 billion yen. It reported a parent current profit of 2.08 billion yen after a loss of 17.21 billion in the previous year.
Nissan Motor Co Ltd's shares shed 25 yen to 780 yen.
